newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks in late rally; Nasdaq sets another high.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks in late rally; Nasdaq sets another high.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks shook off a bad bear day to close higher Tuesday following a recovery in bonds and more strong gains in technology stocks. The Nasdaq composite index racked up its ninth consecutive record close.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow ended up 52.73 points at 7,975.71. The Nasdaq index rose 18.25 points to a new high of 1,542.13.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a small margin on heavy volume of 600 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
